speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe the appearance of the lesion on your left dorsal hand and when you first noticed it?

speaker: Patient
text: It looks like a rough, scaly patch, almost like sandpaper, on the back of my left hand. I noticed it a few weeks ago, and it hasn't changed much since then. However, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you. Since the dermoscopy is normal, I need to narrow down the differential. Have you experienced any itching, pain, or tenderness in the area, and do you have a history of significant sun exposure or work involving manual labor?

speaker: Patient
text: No, it doesn't hurt or itch at all. I do enjoy spending a lot of time outdoors walking and sunbathing, though.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of significant sun exposure and the rough, scaly appearance without symptoms, this is highly suggestive of actinic keratosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Actinic Keratosis
